# scamp_vm_template (Data Source)

Find a VM template by os_type (e.g., 'Ubuntu', 'Alpine').



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `os_type` (String) OS type to search for (e.g., 'Ubuntu', 'Alpine').

### Read-Only

- `api_name` (String) API name of the template.
- `id` (Number) ID of the template.
- `name` (String) Name of the template.
- `os_family` (String) OS family (Linux, Windows, etc.).
- `version` (String) OS version.
